name: Second Peace of Thorn
summary: The Second Peace of Thorn (October 19, 1466) ends the Thirteen Years' War (1454–1466) between Poland and the Teutonic Order. The Order cedes Royal Prussia (including Danzig/Gdańsk, Toruń, and the Vistula delta) to Poland and becomes a Polish vassal for the remaining Teutonic territory (Ducal Prussia). Poland gains Baltic access and the richest agricultural land in the region. The Order is permanently weakened; its Grand Master must now pay homage to the Polish king.

_quarry.structural_significance: Gives Poland Baltic access and dominance; permanently weakens the Teutonic Order as an independent political force; creates the conditions for the Prussian reformation (1525)
